read.en: Applied Optoelectronics fell 7.3% on Nov 10 to $48.32, trading $46.41–51.99. It is below the 5-day ($51.34), 10-day ($61.36), 30-day ($82.88), 100-day ($106.08) and 200-day ($114.79); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($59.24), and RSI is 30.
read.zh: Applied Optoelectronics 11月10日下跌 7.3%，收于 $48.32，盘中区间 $46.41–51.99。股价位于 5 日（$51.34）、10 日（$61.36）、30 日（$82.88）、100 日（$106.08）和 200 日（$114.79）均线下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$59.24），RSI 为 30。

read.en: The drop lost the $50.8–51.9 support (Feb 11 and Nov 6 highs), now resistance with the 5-day ($51.3); the close sat on the $48.3 Nov 9 low after a $46.41 intraday low. Resistance is $50.8–52.0 (5-day, Nov 10 high), then $54.0 (Nov 9 high) and $56.9–57.2. Support is $46.4 (Nov 10 low), then $45.2–45.9 (Nov 5–6 lows). A close above $52 would target $54; below $46.4, $45.2.
